description: This file contains implementations of the Mat4 class methods, including constructors, static transformation matrix generators (rotation, translation, scaling, projection), matrix multiplication, vector transformation, and a dump function for debugging.

classes.name: Mat4
classes.description: A 4x4 matrix class with methods for common transformations and matrix operations.

methods.name: Mat4()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to identity matrix.

methods.name: Mat4(const Matrix<float>)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from a general matrix, copying up to 4x4 elements.

methods.name: Mat4(const std::vector<float>&)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from a vector of 16 floats.

methods.name: Mat4(const float*)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from a pointer to 16 floats.

methods.name: Mat4(float, float, ..., float)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from 16 individual float elements.

methods.name: Rotate
methods.description: Creates a rotation matrix around an axis by a given angle.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Creates a translation matrix for a given vector.

methods.name: Scale
methods.description: Creates a scaling matrix for a given vector.

methods.name: Frustum
methods.description: Creates a frustum projection matrix with specified bounds.

methods.name: Perspective
methods.description: Creates a perspective projection matrix based on field of view and aspect ratio.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Multiplies this matrix with another Mat4.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Transforms a Vector4 by this matrix.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Prints the matrix elements for debugging.
